errors.text: The response declines to formulate any materials hypothesis and therefore does not answer the question.
It omits the hydride-based HfNbTaTiZr ink-extrusion strategy and hydrogen de-binding/vacuum-sintering route.
It omits the controlled oxygen content and quench-dependent stabilization of a metastable single beta-BCC microstructure.
It provides no falsifiable processing conditions, predicted outcomes, boundaries, or discriminating experiment.
